_comment: Machine-readable goal contract for lwcr /pursue. REVISED 2026-06-11 (REVISE-INTERGENIC-PRIMARY-M1, tri-review 3/3 approve-with-modifications + user human gate). FOUNDATIONAL ruler change: intergenic is now the complement of the FULL-transcript span (incl UTR), NOT CDS-only — see scripts/eval_gene_body_mask.py. DUAL CO-PRIMARY design replaces the old single constrained_gene_body_F1 primary. status stays draft until sota_benchmark (M2) is frozen; draft disables full/scale SUCCESS only, screen/Track-A direction-selection works under draft.
goal: Build a cross-species eukaryotic ab initio protein-coding gene annotation model from raw DNA sequence, with structure-aware per-base labels and full/scale evidence strictly exceeding a frozen published SOTA benchmark, improving cross-species intergenic stability WITHOUT sacrificing gene-level F1.
_metrics_note: R6 (revise-goal 2026-06-11, REVISE-INTERGENIC-PRIMARY-M1, tri-review 3/3 + user gate). DUAL CO-PRIMARY (Pareto), reconciling the user's 'elevate intergenic stability to primary' with CLAUDE.md §0 north star (interval/gene-level F1 is the publishable, SOTA-comparable claim axis) and the reviewers' anti-gaming requirement. AXIS 1 (headline / ranking key) = intergenic_specificity = 1 - intergenic_FPR, where intergenic = genome - FULL-transcript span (incl UTR via exon features), DECOUPLED from the gene-body-F1 span_mode (a predicted-genic base in a true UTR is NO LONGER an intergenic FP). base-weighted is the headline value; macro across species is the cross-species-STABILITY gate (selling point). AXIS 2 (publishable claim, SOTA-comparable) = gene-level F1 (screen: gene_body_F1_unconstrained CDS-span; claim: constrained_gene_body_F1). PARETO RULE: a candidate is only better/promotable if it STRICTLY EXCEEDS the anchor on intergenic_specificity AND does not regress gene_body_F1 below the floor (anchor_f1-0.03=0.5276 at screen; anchor_f1=0.5576 for promotion) AND macro_intergenic_specificity holds. This kills both gaming modes proven at M1: FLOOR/ORF (highest specificity 0.8805 but F1 0.3735 < floor -> BLOCKED) and CRF-vec (highest F1 0.6186 but specificity 0.7138 < anchor -> BLOCKED). validate_goal: degenerate-bound + semantic use primary_metric (intergenic_specificity); screen claim_gate uses screen_anchor.metric (intergenic_specificity > 0.8710); the F1 co-primary + macro stability are enforced as HARD guardrails; full/scale SUCCESS requires BOTH success_criteria (both axes beat sota_benchmark).

success_criteria._todo: AXIS 1 claim. Set to the published-SOTA intergenic_specificity under our frozen full eval + NEW ruler (M2 /reproduce-baselines, ANNEVO-compatible). Pending.
AXIS 2 claim (SOTA-comparable, publishable). Set to the published-SOTA gene-level F1 under our frozen full eval (M2). Pending. BOTH axes must hold for a full/scale SUCCESS (Pareto claim).
success_criteria._revision_2026_06_14: REVISE-CONSTRAINED-SOFTGATE (tri-review 3/3 APPROVE-B + user gate). Hard zero (FPR>thr=>0) was R6-pre redundant cliff. screen AXIS-2 now via gene_body_F1_unconstrained>=0.5276 HARD guardrail; full/claim keeps constrained+SOTA-comparable; full FPR<=0.01 HARD retained.

guardrails._note: R6 CO-PRIMARY / anti-gaming RECALL FLOOR (tri-review 3/3 REQUIRED). HARD at screen too (unlike the advisory intergenic_FPR/gene_count guards) because without it the intergenic_specificity ranking is gameable by under-prediction. threshold = anchor_f1(0.5576) - 0.03 tolerance = 0.5276 (Codex max(0.50, anchor-0.03)). Proof it works on M1 same-budget data: FLOOR/ORF F1=0.3735 < 0.5276 BLOCKED; all real candidates (tiberius_like 0.5576, CONSTR 0.5791, CRF-vec 0.6186, helixer_like 0.5579) PASS. Track-B PROMOTION uses the stricter >= anchor_f1 (0.5576), see track_a_promotion. The inert nucleotide_gene_body_F1_drop_vs_anchor guardrail below is the future RELATIVE-drop refinement of this absolute floor.

R6 CROSS-SPECIES STABILITY gate (tri-review 3/3 REQUIRED: macro must be a GATE, not just auxiliary — cross-clade generalization is the selling point; base-weighted alone can hide single-species collapse). threshold = anchor macro (0.8278) - 0.03 tolerance = 0.7978. Emitted by scripts/aggregate_gene_body_metrics.py as macro_intergenic_specificity. PROVISIONAL alongside the anchor: re-derive on a UTR-rich species set before heavy reliance (yeast+fly are low-UTR gene-dense outliers).

R6: intergenic_FPR is now FULL-transcript-based (= 1 - intergenic_specificity; eval ruler changed 2026-06-11). ADVISORY for smoke/screen (reported in metrics + per_species_summary, NOT a hard screen gate — it is the inverse of the AXIS-1 primary, gated via screen_anchor comparison instead). HARD claim guardrail <=0.01 for full/scale only. NOTE the full/scale 0.01 bar is severe: ALL M1 same-budget references fail it (anchor 0.1290, CRF-vec 0.2862) — that is expected at screen budget and is exactly why screen NEVER claims; closing intergenic FP is the core full-data architecture challenge. Always report sensitivity at 0.005/0.01/0.02.

R3/R6: STILL DISABLED (evaluator emits placeholder 0.0 -> would always pass = false assurance). SUPERSEDED for now by the ABSOLUTE gene_body_F1_unconstrained >= 0.5276 floor above, which achieves the same anti-recall-sacrifice protection without the evaluator needing to know the anchor. To ACTIVATE the relative version, make scripts/eval_gene_body_mask.py compute the true drop of a run's nucleotide gene-body F1 vs screen_anchor's gene_body_F1, then restore profiles=[screen,full,scale].

R2/R6 (tri-review approved). HARD claim guardrail at full/scale only; ADVISORY (reported, non-gating) for smoke/screen because the same-budget references themselves fail 1.25 (tiberius_like 1.8-4.1, helixer_like 51-153). Gene-level coherence at screen is enforced by selection discipline (track_a_promotion), not this gate; full/scale claim still requires <=1.25.

semantic_success._note: M1-AGGREGATION-GATE-AUDIT + R6. Distinguish a degenerate/infra failed_run from a finite baseline hard-zeroed by a guardrail (disposition=completed_poor). The bound heuristic (primary==0.0/1.0 -> failed_run) is exempted ONLY with POSITIVE evidence of real signal: gene_body_F1_unconstrained >= 0.05 (the evaluator's constant semantic_success flag is NOT evidence). R6 EDGE NOTE: for the new primary intergenic_specificity, the value 1.0 is a LEGITIMATE optimum (zero intergenic spillover), not necessarily degenerate; a true predict-nothing collapse (spec=1.0, F1=0) still trips failed_run (fails the 0.05 exemption), while a precise model that genuinely hits spec=1.0 with real F1 would be conservatively marked completed_poor by the bound check (known non-fatal limitation; the real quality protection is the gene_body_F1>=0.5276 floor + macro gate + screen_anchor comparison, NOT this bound check). gene-count explosion is a QUALITY problem (predicted_gene_count_ratio guardrail -> not_yet), NOT an infra/degenerate failure.

pretrained_ceiling._note: Reference ONLY, NON-GATING. RECOMPUTED 2026-06-11 under the NEW full-transcript intergenic ruler (R6) on the SAME held-out test subset as the anchor: pretrained Tiberius/Helixer/ANNEVO whole-genome predictions filtered to test seqids, --span-mode cds, base-weighted intergenic_specificity. ceiling = max = Helixer 0.9917 bw / 0.9815 macro (Tiberius 0.9765, ANNEVO 0.9660; gbF1 ceiling = ANNEVO 0.9123). NEW-RULER bracket on intergenic_specificity: FLOOR(ORF) 0.8805 (blocked by F1 floor) < screen_anchor 0.8710 (same-budget) < pretrained_ceiling 0.9917 (full-data) — the ~0.12 anchor->ceiling gap is the data+architecture headroom. NOT read by validate_goal; NEVER a screen or claim gate.
pretrained_ceiling.source: max over pretrained Tiberius(0.9765)/Helixer(0.9917)/ANNEVO(0.9660) base-weighted intergenic_specificity, NEW full-transcript ruler, test subset (scripts/_recompute_ceiling_newruler.py, /tmp/ceiling_newruler). gbF1 ceiling = ANNEVO 0.9123.

screen_anchor._note: PROVISIONAL (user gate 2026-06-11). RECALIBRATED under the NEW full-transcript intergenic ruler (R6). Same-budget bar = max over RANDOM-INIT reference architectures (Tiberius-like, Helixer-like) trained under ONE frozen small-sample screen protocol (yeast+fly, chromosome-level split, window 2048, sample_fraction 0.3, 8 epochs, patience 3, 3 seeds, class-weighted CE), re-scored on the existing held-out test subsets with the new ruler. Metric = intergenic_specificity (base-weighted) = AXIS-1 headline; macro 0.8278 is the cross-species stability co-gate. Anchor = tiberius_like seed-mean 0.8710 (COHERENT, gene_count_ratio 2.74); helixer_like 0.7954 EXCLUDED (it is BOTH lower on specificity AND severely fragmented, gene_count_ratio 99.5). Bracket on the SAME test subset: FLOOR(ORF) intergenic_specificity 0.8805 (HIGHER than anchor!) but gene_body_F1 0.3735 < floor 0.5276 -> correctly BLOCKED, proving the dual-axis gate. screen NEVER claims published SOTA. ⚠️ PROVISIONAL: yeast+fly are gene-dense LOW-UTR OUTLIERS where the UTR ruler-fix is nearly a no-op and true_intergenic_bases is small (FPR denominator noisy); the dramatic CRF-vec ranking flip happened on the species LEAST suited to validate the new ruler. RE-DERIVE on a UTR-rich (mammal/plant) species set before any heavy reliance / Track-B HARD gating (tri-review 3/3).
screen_anchor.source: tiberius_like seed-mean intergenic_specificity 0.8710 base-weighted / 0.8278 macro (NEW full-transcript ruler, REVISE-INTERGENIC-PRIMARY-M1 recompute, /tmp/reanchor_newruler). helixer_like 0.7954 EXCLUDED (lower + fragmented 99.5). FLOOR(ORF) same-subset 0.8805 spec but 0.3735 F1 (blocked by floor). Old-ruler anchor was gene_body_F1=0.5576 (now AXIS-2 anchor_gene_body_F1).

sota_benchmark._note: PENDING M2 baseline reproduction under the NEW ruler. R6 DUAL: a full/scale SUCCESS requires BOTH success_criteria — intergenic_specificity (AXIS 1) AND constrained_gene_body_F1 (AXIS 2, SOTA-comparable) — to strictly exceed the published SOTA reproduced under our frozen full eval. ANNEVO method = primary provenance/metric-audit source. validate_goal's claim_gate at full/scale reads this metric; set it to the AXIS that is the gating claim once frozen (recommend constrained_gene_body_F1 as the SOTA-comparable headline, with intergenic_specificity enforced via success_criteria).
sota_benchmark.source: TODO M2: freeze ANNEVO-compatible full-eval (constrained_gene_body_F1 AND intergenic_specificity) under the NEW full-transcript ruler after comparability audit.

architecture_hypothesis._r6_note: Tri-review 3/3 reframe: the M1 structured decoders (CONSTR, CRF-vec) RAISE gene-body recall/F1 but HURT intergenic_specificity (spill predictions into intergenic DNA). This is NOT 'structured decoders are wrong' — it is 'they need better EMISSIONS + an FP-aware objective'. The correct next lever is BETTER INPUT FEATURES (SegmentNT/GENERanno foundation probe) to reduce intergenic FP without losing recall, THEN semi-CRF + FP-aware objective for gene coherence. CRF-vec is retained as an ABLATION (recall up / specificity down), NOT scaled.

track_a_promotion._note: R6 (revise-goal 2026-06-11, tri-review 3/3). PARETO dual-axis promotion guarding against the proven gaming modes (FLOOR under-prediction; CRF-vec intergenic spillover).
track_a_promotion.screen_pass: candidate intergenic_specificity (base-weighted) STRICTLY EXCEEDS screen_anchor (0.8710) AND gene_body_F1_unconstrained >= floor (0.5276) AND macro_intergenic_specificity >= macro gate (0.7978). Ranking key = intergenic_specificity; gene_body_F1 is eligibility + tiebreak.
track_a_promotion.promotion_stricter_f1: Track-B PROMOTION (not just screen-pass) requires gene_body_F1_unconstrained >= anchor_gene_body_F1 (0.5576) — no F1 regression vs the reference at all, in addition to the strict specificity win.
track_a_promotion.report_seedwise: Track A reports MUST include seed-wise intergenic_specificity (base-weighted + macro) + gene_body_F1 + predicted_gene_count_ratio + per-species rows + paired-seed CI on the specificity gap vs anchor (the M1 flip lacked CI).
track_a_promotion.beats_anchor_is_not_promotable: Beating the anchor on specificity is a direction-selection signal, NOT automatic Track B promotion; promotion also needs the F1 non-regression + a credible plan to hold gene coherence.
track_a_promotion.provisional_anchor_caveat: Until screen_anchor is re-derived on a UTR-rich species set, treat 0.8710/0.7978 as PROVISIONAL screen direction-selection bars, not hard Track-B gates.
